Gold.note: Strong central bank buying and safe-haven demand amid macro uncertainty.

Silver.note: Outperforming gold on robust industrial demand and solar panel manufacturing growth.

Copper.note: Tight concentrates market and robust electrification demand offsetting China property weakness.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear energy momentum support contracting.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new projects outweighing steady EV battery demand growth.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply growth continues to outpace stainless and battery demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charges at record lows indicate tight mine supply constraints.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese steel production caps offset resilient Australian and Brazilian seaborne supply.

Coal.note: High global inventories and demand destruction from energy substitution cap upside.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply chain restructuring and steady EV motor demand support pricing.

Manganese.note: Stable steelmaking demand balanced with ample South African and Gabonese supply.

PGM.note: Auto catalyst substitution from palladium to platinum and hydrogen economy potential.

Potash.note: Tight global supply due to Eastern European export restrictions supports fertilizer demand.

Aluminum.note: Smelter curtailments in China limit supply growth while green transition demand remains robust.

Diversified.note: Broad portfolio exposure to copper and iron ore provides resilience against single-commodity volatility.
